services.name: Custom Private Cruises - Dolphin & Eco, Island, or Bar Crawl $350
services.desc: Fins and Family Fishing's Orange Beach Private Cruises feature the opportunity to choose your own private adventure. Whether you prefer to focus on searching out dolphins and seabirds, going to the beautiful islands of Orange Beach, cruising the shores of Ono Island viewing the million dollar properties, or crawl to various water based restaurants and bars to enjoy a few cocktails we can customize a trip for your crew. The majority of our cruises remain in the calm, protected inshore waters such as bays and bayous but on occasion we will stick our noses out into the nearshore waters of the Gulf of Mexico for a quick peek. services.name: 1 Hr Inshore Remote Controlled Boating Adventure
services.desc: Enjoy a fun time aboard a private vessel on the calm, protected waters of Orange Beach where we will spend time cruising and operating remote controlled boats. The one hour long private experience includes approximately 15-20 minutes run time with the r/c boats and the rest is spent low speed cruising enjoying the sights and sounds of paradise. We frequently see other boaters along with Brown Pelicans, Lesser Terns. Laughing Gulls, Great Blue Herons, and Dolphins. Our R/C boats vary in size and speed.
